N_religious_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a religious vaccination exemption
N_religious_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a religious exemption from vaccination requirements.
N_religious_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students holding a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported by MSDH ("Parent or Patient Refusal: Religious"). Mississippi has not permitted non-religious personal-belief exemptions.
N_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

N_medical_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a medical vaccination exemption
N_medical_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
N_medical_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

ms_school_immunization.name: Mississippi School Immunization Data
ms_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization and exemption data from the annual MSDH reports (religious exemptions permitted after July 2023).
ms_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
